results.name: V1 crypto vectors (FIPS-197, FIPS 180, RFC 6070) + 200 random cross-checks against node:crypto
C1 Python zipfile stored/deflate/bzip2/LZMA: every entry equals Python's read (bytes + CRC)
C2 own inflater == zlib (every deflated corpus entry + node:zlib levels 0–9 + Python entries)
C3 Deflate64 (Windows-made dotnet fixture) == Info-ZIP unzip -p; malformed fixtures end cleanly
C4 Info-ZIP archives: bzip2, forced ZIP64, streamed (data descriptor), symlink, UTF-8 names == unzip
C5 names: CP437 decode == Python; Unicode Path 0x7075 honoured exactly as Info-ZIP does (CRC), stale ignored
E1 WinZip AES read: pyzipper AES-128/192/256 × stored/deflate/bzip2/LZMA
E2 WinZip AES write (128/192/256, stored + deflate): pyzipper decrypts; wrong password refused by pyzipper
E3 ZipCrypto read: Info-ZIP zip -P (files + streamed with a data descriptor)
E4 ZipCrypto write: unzip -P -t passes and Python zipfile reads it
W1 writer: UTF-8 names, folders, comments, Unix modes, timestamps → Python + unzip -t + zipinfo
W2 ZIP64: ours forced → Python + unzip -t; Python force_zip64 → ours; 70 000 entries (count overflow)
X1 editing without the password: AES archive delete/rename/add → pyzipper; streamed ZipCrypto rename → unzip -P -t
N1–N24 negative shapes (zip-slip, symlink, duplicates, overlap, mismatch, bombs, lies, tamper, multi-volume, truncation, limits, methods)
